ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity white/cream pixels on the lateral lobes and 35% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels concentrated in the central isthmus and along the trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central dark-intensity mass originating from the peduncle and extending to the median notch. The left lobe (inner quadrant) contains four distinct, high-contrast diagonal black streaks. The right lobe features a large, contiguous high-intensity white field with dense dark-grey mottling concentrated at the medial-distal boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 62 degrees and a depth ratio of roughly 1/6th of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits a 'sawtooth' pattern with irregular peaks and valleys, while the left lobe shows finer, more uniform micro-serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curve along the trailing edge leading to tapered, slightly recurved fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-texture dark pixel groups located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes and interspersed along the right lobe's trailing edge, corresponding to barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four parallel, linear dark-pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the mid-region of the left lobe; additional vertical linear streaks are visible on the upper-medial surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular geometric deformity at the right fluke tip, showing jagged tissue loss and atypical thickening compared to the left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique mottled 'spray' transition boundary where the central black pigmentation meets the white lateral fields, particularly visible on the right interior lobe.
